mutant.observed: FIRST RUN (before the ADMITS_REGION tightening commit ace4f08d): VERDICT: CLASS-READERS-OK -- the mutant did NOT fire, because the ADMITS check read `content.includes('structured')` over the WHOLE file, and the file's own comment above the array still named both words. This is the DID-NOT-FIRE case the mutant control exists to catch; fixed by scoping ADMITS_REGION to the `ordered: [...]` array itself (commit ace4f08d). SECOND RUN (after the fix, same mutant re-applied): VERDICT: CLASS-READERS-FAIL '_partners/demo/layout.ts: region "ordered:" is missing structured/commodities' -- 0 pass / 1 fail, exactly as expected. Reverted (`git checkout --` on the one file); `git diff --stat` printed no output; IVE46-AC2 re-ran to VERDICT: CLASS-READERS-OK.
